title: Dog leash rules in public
question: Must my dog be on a leash in public places in Poland?
short_answer: Yes. Dogs must be on a leash in most public places. Large/aggressive breeds also require a muzzle.
conditions: Dogs must be on a leash in public spaces (streets, parks, squares)
Large and potentially dangerous breeds must wear a muzzle (kaganiec)
Dangerous dog breeds list is defined by regulation
Dogs may be off-leash in designated dog parks (wybieg dla psów)
Dog must be under owner's control at all times
exceptions: Hunting dogs during hunts are exempt from leash rules
Shepherd/working dogs on duty are exempt
penalties: Fine: 250–500 PLN for unleashed dog in public
Fine: up to 500 PLN if dog attacks a person or another animal due to lack of control
Dog may be seized if owner repeatedly fails to comply

sources.title: Ustawa o ochronie zwierząt – Sejm RP
